name: Overcast
why_listed: Privacy-minded Apple podcast listeners who share short clips with timestamp links would use Overcast instead of Spoken Margins.

platforms.value: iOS, iPadOS, watchOS, macOS (Apple silicon, via App Store), CarPlay; overcast.fm web pages for shared episodes
platforms.note: App Store listing (WebFetch summary) lists iPhone/iPad iOS 18+, Mac macOS 15+ with M1 or later, Apple Watch and CarPlay. No Android or Windows app found.

price_free_tier.value: Full player free, funded by ads that promote other podcasts.
price_free_tier.detail: Free with ads; Premium adds stats, 48-hour history/undo, extra audio effects and ad removal.

sources.title: Overcast - App Store (US)
sources.quote: Overcast is funded by ads that promote other podcasts.

price_paid.value: Overcast Premium: US App Store lists in-app purchases at USD 19.99 and USD 29.99; period not shown on listing
price_paid.detail: Premium is an annual subscription per the overcast.fm home page.
price_paid.note: Overcast.fm home page mentions an annual subscription but shows no price. Press from Nov 2024 reported USD 14.99/year; the App Store's current figures differ and the period of each was not shown, so the cheapest plan is unconfirmed.

plays_podcasts.detail: Full podcast player using standard RSS feeds.

sources.title: Overcast - App Store (US)
sources.quote: Smart Speed saves time without distorting the audio

reads_web_articles_aloud.note: Checked home page and App Store listing; nothing about reading articles aloud.

reads_pdfs_aloud.note: Checked home page and App Store listing; nothing about PDFs.

voice_notes_anchored.detail: No note or bookmark feature found.
voice_notes_anchored.note: Checked home page and App Store listing including recent release notes; no notes or bookmarks mentioned.

text_notes_anchored.detail: No note or bookmark feature found.
text_notes_anchored.note: Checked home page and App Store listing including recent release notes; no notes or bookmarks mentioned.

hands_free_capture.detail: No hands-free moment capture found; the Watch app and CarPlay are for playback.
hands_free_capture.note: App Store listing mentions a standalone Apple Watch app and CarPlay for playback only.

transcripts.detail: Live-scrolling transcripts for most podcasts, free for everyone; iOS 26 devices can generate missing ones.

sources.title: Overcast launches podcast transcripts in new app update for iPhone - 9to5Mac
sources.quote: Developer Marco Arment says transcripts are available for 'most podcasts,' but even if a show doesn't have a transcript yet, AI-compatible devices running iOS 26 can create the transcript automatically.

sources.title: Overcast - App Store (US)
sources.quote: Transcripts! (Many more transcript features coming in the future, too. Gotta start somewhere, though!)

transcripts.note: Press source used because the vendor's own pages have only a release-note line.

ai_summaries.detail: AI summaries and automatic chapters are on the developer's roadmap, not shipped as of the pages read.

sources.title: Overcast launches podcast transcripts in new app update for iPhone - 9to5Mac
sources.quote: Arment has shared that the following enhancements are on his roadmap: Transcript search, AI-based transcript analysis such as summaries, automatic chapters, etc.

ai_summaries.note: Roadmap as of April 2026; App Store release notes through 2026-08-24 mention no summaries.

export_markdown_pkm.detail: No export to note apps found. Transcripts can be exported as SRT.
export_markdown_pkm.note: App Store 'What's New' (2026.8.1) mentions transcript SRT export per WebFetch summary; no Obsidian/Notion/Readwise/Markdown export found.

share_note_at_moment.detail: Share audio or video clips up to a minute, or an overcast.fm link queued to the clip's timestamp; no note travels with it.

sources.title: Clip sharing with Overcast – Marco.org
sources.quote: you can now share audio or video clips, up to a minute each, from any public podcast.

sources.title: Overcast - App Store (US)
sources.quote: Fixed missing artwork in clip-sharing and stalls while exporting clips

share_note_at_moment.note: Timestamped links look like overcast.fm/+id/44:22 per the post; landing pages show badges for other podcast apps.

group_listening.detail: No group or shared annotation feature found.
group_listening.note: Checked home page and App Store listing; nothing either way.

on_device_privacy.detail: Accounts are anonymous by default (no email/password), and the app has no third-party analytics, ad services or tracking code.

sources.title: Overcast's privacy policy
sources.quote: New Overcast accounts are created anonymously, without email addresses or passwords.

sources.title: Overcast - App Store (US)
sources.quote: Overcast has world-class privacy, with no third-party analytics, ad services, or tracking code.

on_device_privacy.note: Listening data (podcasts, episodes, activity) is still synced to Overcast servers; this is no-account-required privacy, not on-device-only storage.

account_required.detail: An anonymous account is created automatically; email and password are optional.

sources.title: Overcast's privacy policy
sources.quote: New Overcast accounts are created anonymously, without email addresses or passwords.
